strings.text: A Pier on a Mountain Lake
strings.translation: Um píer num lago de montanha

strings.text: The water went still before the light went out.
strings.translation: A água se aquietou antes de a luz se apagar.

strings.text: The last light is slipping behind the ridge.
strings.translation: A última luz está escorregando para trás da serra.

strings.text: The lantern was lit a little earlier than it needed to be.
strings.translation: A lanterna foi acesa um pouco antes do que precisava.

strings.text: The boat quietly tugs at its rope and goes still again.
strings.translation: O barco puxa de leve a corda e fica imóvel de novo.
